title: Canonical open political/election market list (Kalshi)
purpose: The complete list of open Kalshi political and election markets captured by this project, with the contest-eligibility verdict for every row, and a reconciliation ladder that shows where every other count went.
listFileNote: Overwritten on every run so the repository does not grow by a multi-megabyte duplicate each day. The underlying capture (data/kalshi/forward/universe-open.json + data/kalshi/tracker/daily/*.csv) is the append-only record.

reconciliationLadder.method: GET /events?status=open&with_nested_markets=true&limit=200 — every open event on the exchange, all categories
events whose series is in the Elections/Politics registry or whose own category is Elections/Politics
derived US-election flag — see US_ELECTION_TAGS in scripts/collect-kalshi.mjs
markets nested in the kept events
status finalized: recorded as settlements and excluded from the daily panel
zero lifetime volume AND zero open interest: counted, not listed
volume > 0 or open_interest > 0 — the panel this repo treats as tradeable
derived US-election flag over the API series tags

reconciliationLadder.step: 6. full open list in this artifact
7. contest-eligible markets on the last captured day
reconciliationLadder.method: US-election series + captured panel + two-sided book + close_time inside the season window

reconciliationLadder.step: 7b. …excluded by the season window (2028-cycle rows open today)
reconciliationLadder.method: close_time after 2027-12-31T23:59:59Z — open now, settles years from now, outside the 2026 season (see SEASON in src/contest/forward-universe.js)
volume_24h > 0 — the only markets the contest engine will fill in

reconciliationLadder.step: X1. independent Python collector, exchange-wide active markets
reconciliationLadder.method: https://external-api.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2 GET /markets?status=open (top 2000 by volume listed) — a DIFFERENT query shape from rung 3, so the totals are not expected to match

reconciliationLadder.step: X2. independent Python collector, politics-filtered markets
reconciliationLadder.method: client-side filter on the allowlist of 4,185 politics/elections series

universeDefinition: contest-eligible = the market's series carries the collected US-election tag, the market appears in that day's captured panel with a two-sided book (yes_bid > 0, yes_ask < 1), and its close_time is strictly after that date. Defined once, in src/contest/forward-universe.js.
discrepancies: Measurement note (not an error): this list holds 24147 markets from https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?series_ticker={each politics/elections series}&status=open (cursor-paginated), while the daily events feed recorded 24368 open political/election markets at 2026-09-23T17:21:59.331Z. The two use different endpoints (/markets?series_ticker=… per series vs /events?status=open) and are captured minutes apart, so small differences are expected; a large one means one of the collectors changed behaviour and should be investigated.
